## e) Désaisonnaliser et décomposer la série corrigée à partir des méthodes X13-SARIMA-SEATS

```{r}
# 1. Modèle RegARIMA X13
reg_x13 <- regarima_x13(serie_corrigee, spec = "RG5c")

# Résumé du modèle
summary(reg_x13)

# 2. Test log vs niveau (additif ou multiplicatif)
s_transform(reg_x13)

# 3. Désaisonnalisation complète
mod_x13 <- x13(serie_corrigee)

# Extraction des composantes
serie_sa    <- mod_x13$final$series[, "sa"]   # série désaisonnalisée
serie_trend <- mod_x13$final$series[, "t"]    # tendance
serie_seas  <- mod_x13$final$series[, "s"]    # saisonnalité
serie_irreg <- mod_x13$final$series[, "i"]    # irrégulier

# 4. Graphiques
plot(mod_x13)

# 5. Résumé du modèle complet
summary(mod_x13)

# 6. Détails du modèle ARIMA sous-jacent
summary(mod_x13$regarima)
```

```{r}
# Résidus X13
res_x13 <- residuals(mod_x13$regarima)

acf(res_x13, main = "ACF des résidus du modèle X13")

Box.test(res_x13, lag = 12, type = "Ljung-Box")
```


# Prévision de la série saisonnière corrigée des points atypiques sur une année

## a) Estimation et prévision

### (i) méthodes naïve

```{r}
h <- 12

# 1. Méthode naïve saisonnière
mod_naive <- snaive(serie_corrigee, h = h)
mod_naive
plot(mod_naive)

# 2. X13-SARIMA-SEATS
mod_x13 <- x13(serie_corrigee)

# résumé général
summary(mod_x13)

# modèle RegARIMA / SARIMA 
summary(mod_x13$regarima)

# log ou level
s_transform(mod_x13$regarima)

# prévisions sur 1 an
prev_x13 <- mod_x13$final$forecasts
prev_x13

# graphiques X13
plot(mod_x13)

# 3. STL
mod_stl <- stlm(serie_corrigee, s.window = "periodic")
mod_stl

prev_stl <- forecast(mod_stl, h = h)
prev_stl

plot(prev_stl)

# 4. STS
mod_sts <- StructTS(serie_corrigee)
mod_sts

# variances du modèle STS
mod_sts$coef

# prévisions sur 1 an
prev_sts <- forecast(mod_sts, h = h)
prev_sts

plot(prev_sts)
```


### (ii) méthodes de lissage exponentiel

```{r}
h <- 12

# 1. Holt-Winters
mod_hw <- hw(serie_corrigee, seasonal = "additive", h = h)
summary(mod_hw)
plot(mod_hw)

# 2. ETS
mod_ets <- ets(serie_corrigee)
summary(mod_ets)

prev_ets <- forecast(mod_ets, h = h)
prev_ets
plot(prev_ets)

# 3. TBATS
mod_tbats <- tbats(serie_corrigee)
summary(mod_tbats)

prev_tbats <- forecast(mod_tbats, h = h)
prev_tbats
plot(prev_tbats)

# 4. ADAM
mod_adam <- adam(serie_corrigee, h = h)
summary(mod_adam)

prev_adam <- forecast(mod_adam, h = h)
prev_adam
plot(prev_adam)
```


### (iii) les modèles SARIMA(p,d,q)(P,D,Q)12 et SSARIMA

```{r}
h <- 12

# 1. SARIMA automatique
mod_sarima_auto <- auto.arima(
  serie_corrigee,
  seasonal = TRUE,
  stepwise = FALSE,
  approximation = FALSE
)

summary(mod_sarima_auto)

# Prévisions
prev_sarima_auto <- forecast(mod_sarima_auto, h = h)

# Graphique
plot(prev_sarima_auto)

# 2. SARIMA manuel (exemple avec X13)
mod_sarima_manual <- Arima(
  serie_corrigee,
  order = c(1,1,1),
  seasonal = c(0,1,1)
)

summary(mod_sarima_manual)

# Prévisions
prev_sarima_manual <- forecast(mod_sarima_manual, h = h)

# Graphique
plot(prev_sarima_manual)

# 3. SSARIMA (sur série désaisonnalisée)

# On utilise la série SA (X13)
serie_sa <- mod_x13$final$series[, "sa"]

# Modèle ARIMA sur série sans saisonnalité
mod_ssarima <- auto.arima(
  serie_sa,
  seasonal = FALSE
)

summary(mod_ssarima)

# Prévisions sur série désaisonnalisée
prev_ssarima_sa <- forecast(mod_ssarima, h = h)

# Re-saisonnalisation
# On récupère les coefficients saisonniers
seasonality <- mod_x13$final$series[, "s"]

# On prend les 12 derniers mois de saisonnalité
last_season <- tail(seasonality, 12)

# On répète pour horizon h
season_future <- rep(last_season, length.out = h)

# Reconstruction série finale
prev_ssarima <- prev_ssarima_sa$mean * season_future

# Graphique
ts.plot(serie_corrigee, prev_ssarima, col = c("black", "blue"))
```

```{r}
# Diagnostics ETS
checkresiduals(mod_ets)

# Diagnostics SARIMA auto
checkresiduals(mod_sarima_auto)
```

```{r}
# TABLEAU COMPARATIF DES MODELES

# petite fonction utilitaire : renvoie 1 seul nombre ou NA
safe_num <- function(x) {
  out <- tryCatch(x, error = function(e) NA)
  out <- as.numeric(out)
  if (length(out) == 0) return(NA_real_)
  out[1]
}

  Modele = c(
```

# Qualité de prévision : MSE et R2OOS de tous les modèles + graphique 

```{r}
#Split train / test (pour OOS)

# horizon de test = 12 mois
h <- 12

# taille totale
n <- length(serie_corrigee)

# train / test
train <- window(serie_corrigee, end = time(serie_corrigee)[n - h])
test  <- window(serie_corrigee, start = time(serie_corrigee)[n - h + 1])
```


```{r}
#Ré-estimer TOUS les modèles sur TRAIN

# NAIVE
mod_naive <- snaive(train, h = h)

# X13
mod_x13 <- x13(train)
prev_x13 <- mod_x13$final$forecasts[, "y_f"]

# STL
mod_stl <- stlm(train, s.window = "periodic")
prev_stl <- forecast(mod_stl, h = h)$mean

# STS
mod_sts <- StructTS(train)
prev_sts <- forecast(mod_sts, h = h)$mean

# HOLT-WINTERS
mod_hw <- hw(train, seasonal = "additive", h = h)

# ETS
mod_ets <- ets(train)
prev_ets <- forecast(mod_ets, h = h)$mean

# TBATS
mod_tbats <- tbats(train)
prev_tbats <- forecast(mod_tbats, h = h)$mean

# ADAM
mod_adam <- adam(train)
prev_adam <- forecast(mod_adam, h = h)

# SARIMA auto
mod_sarima_auto <- auto.arima(train)
prev_sarima_auto <- forecast(mod_sarima_auto, h = h)$mean

# SARIMA manuel
mod_sarima_manual <- Arima(train, order = c(1,1,1), seasonal = c(0,1,1))
prev_sarima_manual <- forecast(mod_sarima_manual, h = h)$mean

# SSARIMA (sur série SA)
mod_x13_train <- x13(train)
serie_sa_train <- mod_x13_train$final$series[, "sa"]

mod_ssarima <- auto.arima(serie_sa_train, seasonal = FALSE)
prev_ssarima_sa <- forecast(mod_ssarima, h = h)$mean

# re-saisonnalisation
seasonality <- mod_x13_train$final$series[, "s"]
last_season <- tail(seasonality, 12)
season_future <- rep(last_season, length.out = h)

prev_ssarima <- prev_ssarima_sa * season_future
```


```{r}
#Mettre toutes les prévisions ensemble

predictions <- list(
  naive = mod_naive$mean,
  x13 = prev_x13,
  stl = prev_stl,
  sts = prev_sts,
  hw = mod_hw$mean,
  ets = prev_ets,
  tbats = prev_tbats,
  adam = prev_adam$mean,
  sarima_auto = prev_sarima_auto,
  sarima_manual = prev_sarima_manual,
  ssarima = prev_ssarima
)
```

```{r}
#Fonction MSE

mse <- function(y, yhat) {
  mean((y - yhat)^2, na.rm = TRUE)
}

#Calcul MSE pour chaque modèle

mse_results <- sapply(predictions, function(p) mse(test, p))
mse_results
```

```{r}
#R² OOS (out-of-sample)

mse_naive <- mse_results["naive"]

r2_oos <- 1 - (mse_results / mse_naive)
r2_oos
```


```{r}
#tableau final 

resultats <- data.frame(
  Modele = names(mse_results),
  MSE = as.numeric(mse_results),
  R2_OOS = as.numeric(r2_oos)
)

resultats[order(resultats$MSE), ]
```


```{r}
#CSPE (Cumulative Squared Prediction Error)
cspe <- function(y, yhat) {
  cumsum((y - yhat)^2)
}

cspe_list <- lapply(predictions, function(p) cspe(test, p))

#graphique CSPE 
plot(cspe_list[[1]], type = "l", col = 1, lwd = 2,
     ylab = "CSPE", xlab = "Temps",
     main = "Comparaison CSPE")

for(i in 2:length(cspe_list)){
  lines(cspe_list[[i]], col = i, lwd = 2)
}

legend("topleft",
       legend = names(cspe_list),
       col = 1:length(cspe_list),
       lty = 1, cex = 0.8)
```


# Test de Diebold-Mariano : comparaison avec le modèle AR(1)

```{r}
h_dm <- 24
n <- length(serie_corrigee)

test_dm <- window(
  serie_corrigee,
  start = time(serie_corrigee)[n - h_dm + 1]
)

fc_1step <- function(train, model_name){
  
  if(model_name == "naive"){
    fit <- snaive(train, h = 1)
    return(as.numeric(fit$mean))
  }
  
  if(model_name == "x13"){
    fit <- x13(train)
    return(as.numeric(fit$final$forecasts[1, "y_f"]))
  }
  
  if(model_name == "stl"){
    fit <- stlm(train, s.window = "periodic")
    return(as.numeric(forecast(fit, h = 1)$mean))
  }
  
  if(model_name == "sts"){
    fit <- StructTS(train)
    return(as.numeric(forecast(fit, h = 1)$mean))
  }
  
  if(model_name == "hw"){
    fit <- hw(train, seasonal = "additive", h = 1)
    return(as.numeric(fit$mean))
  }
  
  if(model_name == "ets"){
    fit <- ets(train)
    return(as.numeric(forecast(fit, h = 1)$mean))
  }
  
  if(model_name == "tbats"){
    fit <- tbats(train)
    return(as.numeric(forecast(fit, h = 1)$mean))
  }
  
  if(model_name == "adam"){
    fit <- adam(train)
    return(as.numeric(forecast(fit, h = 1)$mean))
  }
  
  if(model_name == "sarima_auto"){
    fit <- auto.arima(train, seasonal = TRUE)
    return(as.numeric(forecast(fit, h = 1)$mean))
  }
  
  if(model_name == "sarima_manual"){
    fit <- Arima(train, order = c(1,1,1), seasonal = c(0,1,1))
    return(as.numeric(forecast(fit, h = 1)$mean))
  }
  
  if(model_name == "ssarima"){
    fit_x13 <- x13(train)
    sa_train <- fit_x13$final$series[, "sa"]
    fit <- auto.arima(sa_train, seasonal = FALSE)
    fc_sa <- as.numeric(forecast(fit, h = 1)$mean)
    
    # Re-saisonnalisation avec le dernier coefficient saisonnier
    seas <- fit_x13$final$series[, "s"]
    seas_next <- tail(seas, 1)
    
    return(fc_sa * seas_next)
  }
  
  if(model_name == "ar1"){
    fit <- Arima(train, order = c(1,0,0))
    return(as.numeric(forecast(fit, h = 1)$mean))
  }
}
```

```{r}
# Test de Diebold-Mariano chaque modèle est comparé au modèle AR(1)

modeles <- c(
  "naive", "x13", "stl", "sts", "hw", "ets", "tbats",
  "adam", "sarima_auto", "sarima_manual", "ssarima"
)

preds_1step <- lapply(modeles, function(m) numeric(h_dm))
names(preds_1step) <- modeles

pred_ar1 <- numeric(h_dm)

for (i in 1:h_dm) {
  
  train_i <- window(
    serie_corrigee,
    end = time(serie_corrigee)[n - h_dm + i - 1]
  )
  
  pred_ar1[i] <- fc_1step(train_i, "ar1")
  
  for (m in modeles) {
    preds_1step[[m]][i] <- fc_1step(train_i, m)
  }
}

dm_table <- data.frame(
  Modele = character(),
  DM_stat = numeric(),
  p_value = numeric(),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

for(m in modeles){
  
  e_model <- as.numeric(test_dm) - preds_1step[[m]]
  e_ar1 <- as.numeric(test_dm) - pred_ar1
  
  dm_res <- dm.test(
    e1 = e_model,
    e2 = e_ar1,
    alternative = "less",
    h = 1,
    power = 2,
    varestimator = "bartlett"
  )
  
  dm_table <- rbind(
    dm_table,
    data.frame(
      Modele = m,
      DM_stat = as.numeric(dm_res$statistic),
      p_value = dm_res$p.value
    )
  )
}

dm_table <- dm_table[order(dm_table$p_value), ]
dm_table
```
